main_text.p: oraculo facere jubentur Crotoniatae δῶ-ρον δ᾽ ὅτι δῶ τις ἐπαινεῖ, qvodqve plebeio fertur adagio, qvid plebeium voco, qvo usus est S. Hieronymus, noli dentes equi donati inspicere, introspexi enim & attente legi & consideravi ingeniosissimum illud & eloqventissimum Poëma, nihilqve spem meam fefellit, aut admirationem praeceptam minuit. Idem mihi accidit, qvod splendida palatia, aut ingentes montes prospicientibus. Eminus palatiorum mirantur lata moenia, minaces turres, sublimia tecta, totiusq; operis molem & splendorem, cominus vero murorum compages, vestibula, porticus, tabulata laqvearia, universamqve architectonicen stupent: montium qvoqve magnitudo qvo propius accedimus, eo procerior & altior apparet; ita mihi Poëma tuum minutim consideranti, & ad singula verba mentem advertenti, qvae prius ἐν πλάτει, ut ita dicam, & in fasce elegantia, erudita, & ingeniose elaborata judicaveram, admirationi fuêre, meqve tenuis & jejunae laudis poeni-tuit.

page.notes: The Greek in the first line and in "ἐν πλάτει" is copied from the scan, with accents as far as they are legible. A stray "O" sits at the left of the last line, below the text; it is not part of the sentence and is left out of the text. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The left edge carries scanner marks and show-through, which are left out.
